desc: Analyze the problem and derive the $O(N)$ approach using cumulative displacements and a hash set.
Implement the $O(N)$ algorithm using a hash set to track "new" cumulative displacement positions, then iterate through the wind string to build the result string.
Handle input parsing and output formatting.
Test with provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Ensure edge cases (e.g., $N=1$, repeated wind directions) are handled correctly by the set logic.
